title: Article 19 — Six freedoms and reasonable restrictions

content.overview: Article 19(1) guarantees specified freedoms to citizens. Clauses (2)–(6) permit only reasonable restrictions on the grounds enacted in those clauses.
content.study: Identify the freedom first, then the restriction and authorising clause. Article 19 rights are citizen rights. After Maneka, Articles 14, 19 and 21 form a golden triangle when liberty is also engaged.

sections.heading: Speech and expression
sections.body: Restrictions must fall within Article 19(2) grounds. Vague bans attract close scrutiny.
